name: Function length
description: Flags functions/events whose body is longer than a configurable line count.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, a `Function` or `Event` whose body between the header and `EndFunction`/`EndEvent` exceeds `function_length_max_code_lines` (non-blank, non-comment lines; default 10 on the built-in/`strict` preset, 20 on `standard`, and 40 on `careful`) or `function_length_max_lines` (every physical line; default 20 / 40 / 60). Native stubs and CreationKit fragment-wrapper handlers are not counted.
